complexity.notes: s.lower() creates an O(n) copy; this could be avoided by lowercasing individual characters on comparison for O(1) extra space. The left-pointer skip loop correctly guards against running off the end (all-non-alphanumeric input), while the right-pointer loop needs no guard since it can never cross below the left pointer's position.
complexity.summary: Lowercases the string, then uses two pointers from both ends, skipping non-alphanumeric characters and comparing matching characters until the pointers meet.
